subject: Staff credential pack and training certificates for SOC2 / SIG review
body:
From: Elena Hartwell <elena.hartwell@hartwell.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: staff credentials & training certs for SOC2 scope

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. As part of our SIG/SOC2 readiness exercise we need a compact evidence bundle showing: background screening checks for staff with access to customer data, recent security training certificates (last 12 months), and the current onboarding/offboarding checklist used by HR/IT. Ideally we can get a single package (redacted where needed) plus a manifest that lists which employees and roles are included.

Can you send this over or point me to a secure link? Our internal deadline is Oct 25.

Best,
Elena
Audit Manager, Hartwell Analytics

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Hartwell <elena.hartwell@hartwell.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staff credentials & training certs for SOC2 scope

Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (security/compliance) and Laura (ops) to pull the artifacts. Quick clarifying points so we deliver exactly what you need:

- Do you need certificates for contractors or only full-time employees?
- Preferred format for the manifest: CSV with role and redaction markers, or a human-readable PDF?
- Any special PII redaction rules beyond names and SSNs (we normally redact personal identifiers and keep employment IDs)?

We can package redacted background check summaries (pass/clearance date + role), training certs (PDFs), and the onboarding/offboarding checklist (xls). We will provide a signed transmittal and a checksum manifest.

Ben
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Hartwell <elena.hartwell@hartwell.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staff credentials & training certs for SOC2 scope

Thanks Ben. Elena — we prepared the artifact pack this morning. Contents attached and summarized below: 

- redacted-backgrounds-batch.pdf (PDF, redactions applied to DOB and national identifiers; shows role, hire date, screening vendor, and clearance status)
- training-certificates-2026.zip (ZIP, individual PDF certs for 148 staff; training event: "Security Awareness 2026" with timestamps)
- onboard-offboard-checklist-2026.xlsx (Excel, current HR/IT checklist with owner and step timestamps)
- manifest-credentials.csv (CSV, employee_id*, role, artifact filenames, checksum)

*Note: manifest uses internal employee_id instead of PII. We redacted full names in the exported PDF bundle but include role-level mapping in the manifest. If you require name-level mapping for scoped roles, we can provide a redacted mapping under an NDA/secure channel.

Transmittal notes: files uploaded to a secured Redwoods S3 bucket. Access link below is expiring in 14 days. We also included a short README describing redaction rules and screening vendor contact.

Access link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/HR/SOC2/Hartwell_Artifact_Pack_2026
Checksum (manifest CRC32): 3a7f9b2c

We attached the three artifact filenames to this thread for your reference. Let me know if you need contractor certs; I can append those too.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Hartwell <elena.hartwell@hartwell.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staff credentials & training certs for SOC2 scope

Elena — bundle is live at the link Karthik shared. We included a short transmittal PDF with sign-off from HR and Security. Attachment manifest and files are attached here for quick reference. If you need the files delivered via DocuSign or a different transfer method, let us know and we can reroute.

Attachments: training-certificates-2026.zip (attachment stub), redacted-backgrounds-batch.pdf (attachment stub), onboard-offboard-checklist-2026.xlsx (attachment stub)

Thanks for the quick turnaround window.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

---

On Tue, 20 Oct 2026 at 16:22:00 +0000, Elena Hartwell <elena.hartwell@hartwell.ai> wrote:

> Hi Laura and team,
>
> Thank you — reviewed the bundle and it looks good. One small ask: could you provide the manifest with contractor flagging (yes/no) in column D? That will help our scoping. Also, we need one small redaction change in the background bundle for a contractor whose candidate ID is visible — can you re-run that page with the ID masked?
>
> If you can send an updated manifest and a corrected single-page replacement, we can finalize acceptance by Oct 23.
>
> Best,
> Elena
